**Risk flags:**
- Single shareholder holds 94.06%

**Overview:**  
Everbright Murni Plastik Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited manufacturing firm that specialises in precision machining of metal parts for electronics. It is incorporated on 14 Nov 1996 and operates in Pulau Pinang, Malaysia. The company has a share capital of RM 250,000, two directors, and a dominant shareholder owning 94.06% of the equity. Reported revenues are RM 6,136,596; RM 8,282,936; and RM 11,475,475 (years not specified). No legal cases are recorded, and no audit opinions or profitability metrics are provided.
